comparison_id: NORMALIZATION_NOTE=The G0 C oracle prints an extra trailing status field on its CA lines; the
NORMALIZATION_NOTE=harness does not. The normalizer reduces both to the canonical
NORMALIZATION_NOTE=(site, input_1, input_2, result, value) form before the comparison. The
NORMALIZATION_NOTE=status field is 0 for every G0 CA row (the C predicate has no failure
NORMALIZATION_NOTE=mode) and is therefore not a semantic discriminator.
COMPARISON_METHOD=token-by-token, per site, over the whole 146-row population
